meta.subject: English
meta.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review
meta.title: Rubric Check: Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The students who studied abroad received awards, which one-word term describes whether who studied abroad limits the meaning of students?
questions.explanation: The clause who studied abroad narrows the reference of students to a particular group, so it is restrictive.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which verb correctly completes the sentence: The final report is scheduled to ___ at noon?
questions.explanation: A passive infinitive uses to followed by the base verb publish.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The crew repaired the roof after the storm passed. Which one-word label identifies the function of the clause after the storm passed within the sentence?
questions.explanation: The clause after the storm passed functions adverbially because it tells when the crew repaired the roof.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The roster of new volunteers are scheduled to arrive before noon. Which one-word rubric category should flag the error?
questions.explanation: Because roster is singular, the verb should be is, making the error one of subject-verb agreement.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The visitors, a group of students, were waiting outside, which verb agrees with the subject?
questions.explanation: The plural subject visitors takes the plural verb were, while the appositive phrase does not control agreement.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The committee has approved the revised proposal, which one-word term names the grammatical function of has?
questions.explanation: Has combines with approved to form the present perfect verb phrase, so it functions as an auxiliary.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: How should the sentence The bell rang, and the students left the building, be classified?
questions.explanation: The sentence is compound because it contains two independent clauses joined by the coordinating conjunction and.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which word correctly completes the sentence: If the alarm had sounded earlier, the firefighters would have ___ to the smoke?
questions.explanation: Responded is the past participle required after would have in a third conditional sentence.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence Each of the students submitted a report. Which one-word grammar label identifies Each?
questions.explanation: Each is an indefinite pronoun because it refers to the students without identifying any one of them individually.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer revises Lena is more taller than Priya to Lena is taller than Priya. Which rubric category should identify the original error?
questions.explanation: More cannot stand before the comparative form taller because standard English uses either more tall or taller, not both.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which reflexive pronoun correctly completes the sentence: Ms. Alvarez asked Elena to describe ___ to the class?
questions.explanation: The reflexive pronoun herself refers to Elena, the person performing the action of describing.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The scientist whose experiment failed requested a review, which noun does whose modify?
questions.explanation: Whose functions as a possessive determiner and indicates that the experiment belongs to the scientist.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence Priya, a marathon champion, finished the race. What grammatical term names the phrase a marathon champion?
questions.explanation: The phrase a marathon champion renames Priya in apposition, so it is an appositive.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which grammatical function does the phrase rehearsing for weeks have in The finalists, rehearsing for weeks, delivered a confident presentation?
questions.explanation: The participial phrase rehearsing for weeks modifies the noun finalists and therefore functions as a modifier.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In formal edited prose, which relative pronoun belongs in the sentence: The candidate ___ the voters chose became mayor?
questions.explanation: Because the pronoun is the object of chose, formal edited prose requires the objective-case relative pronoun whom.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which conjunction correctly completes the sentence: No sooner had the game ended ___ the crowd began chanting?
questions.explanation: The fixed correlative construction no sooner...than pairs had with than to express the earlier event.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which one-word rubric category should flag Because the roads were icy and the bus service had been suspended as a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: This construction is a fragment because the Because-clause is dependent and no independent clause completes the thought.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence When Maria told Elena that she had won the scholarship, they celebrated together. Which one-word problem makes the sentence unclear?
questions.explanation: The pronoun she can refer to either Maria or Elena, creating ambiguity.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which verb correctly completes the sentence: Each of the judges currently ___ a different scorecard?
questions.explanation: The singular subject each takes the third-person singular present-tense verb holds.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which word correctly completes the sentence: After moving to a new city, Elena is used to ___ early?
questions.explanation: Waking is a gerund, which is the form required after the phrase is used to.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which verb correctly completes the sentence: A set of rare coins from Spain was auctioned at the charity event last weekend?
questions.explanation: Was agrees with the singular noun set, and the time expression last weekend requires the past tense.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the formal sentence The manager insisted that every employee complete the form by Friday, what mood labels the clause after that?
questions.explanation: The verb complete is in the mandative subjunctive because it follows insisted that and expresses the employee's required action.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The committee, along with several advisers, are reviewing the proposal, which noun determines the verb agreement under standard subject-verb agreement rules?
questions.explanation: The committee is the subject, and the intervening phrase along with several advisers does not change its number.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence Having completed the analysis, the laptop was closed, which noun creates the dangling modifier?
questions.explanation: The laptop is the main-clause subject, so it cannot logically perform the action of completing the analysis.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which construction is created by placing the auxiliary Had before the subject in Had the warning sounded, everyone would have evacuated?
questions.explanation: Inversion is the placement of the auxiliary before the subject in the fronted conditional clause.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The team practiced carefully, but the final performance was uneven. Which grammatical class does but belong to?
questions.explanation: But is a coordinating conjunction because it joins two independent clauses that could stand alone separately.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which auxiliary correctly completes the sentence: By the time the ambulance arrived, the injured cyclist ___ already been treated and transported to the hospital?
questions.explanation: Had forms the past perfect tense required for the earlier treatment in the past time frame.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which past-tense form correctly completes the sentence: The nurse ___ the child down gently?
questions.explanation: Laid is the past tense of lay and means placed the child down.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which word correctly completes the sentence: The revised essay discusses, analyzes, and ___ the evidence?
questions.explanation: Evaluates maintains third-person singular present tense and parallels discusses and analyzes.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which grammatical term names the noun or noun phrase for which a pronoun stands?
questions.explanation: An antecedent is the noun or noun phrase that a pronoun stands for.
questions.skill: Identifying antecedents in a grammar rubric
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The hikers reach the trailhead at noon and then hiked for three hours. Which grammatical feature changes unexpectedly within the sentence?
questions.explanation: The sentence shifts from the present-tense verb reach to the past-tense verb hiked without establishing a time shift.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which reflexive pronoun correctly completes the sentence: The director thanked the volunteers for organizing the event by themselves?
questions.explanation: Themselves is the plural reflexive pronoun that refers to the volunteers, the subject of organizing.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which word correctly completes the sentence: The evidence was collected, analyzed, and ___ in the final report?
questions.explanation: Summarized is the past-tense participle that matches collected and analyzed in the passive parallel list.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The professor, who had invited the students, entered the lecture hall, what does the relative pronoun who refer to?
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun who refers to the professor and introduces the clause that had invited the students.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which form correctly completes the present-tense sentence: Either of the two options ___ a valid solution for this task?
questions.explanation: Offers agrees with the singular antecedent either and preserves the present tense.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the formal sentence: The prize was shared between the teacher and I. Which one-word case label applies to the pronoun required after between?
questions.explanation: Between is a preposition, so the pronoun after it is me, which takes the objective case.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which conjunction introduces an indirect question that asks whether one of two alternatives is true?
questions.explanation: Whether introduces an indirect question that presents two or more alternatives.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The train was delayed, we took a different route. Which one-word rubric category should flag its punctuation problem?
questions.explanation: The two independent clauses are joined only by a comma, creating a splice.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In The panel approved the budget after reviewing both proposals, which one-word label names the complete verb phrase?
questions.explanation: The complete verb phrase, approved the budget after reviewing both proposals, functions as the sentence's predicate.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which one-word linguistic term names the omission of repeated words in Maria likes jazz, and Peter does too?
questions.explanation: In Peter does too, the understood phrase is Peter likes jazz, creating ellipsis.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the possessive phrase the coaches whistle, which one-word punctuation label names the mark needed after coaches?
questions.explanation: To show possession, coaches becomes coaches', and the required mark is an apostrophe.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In the sentence The exhausted hikers rested beneath a shady tree, which one-word term identifies the verb form exhausted?
questions.explanation: Exhausted is a past participle used adjectivally to describe the hikers.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which word correctly completes the sentence: The instructor asked the students to ___ their conclusions with evidence?
questions.explanation: Defend is the base form required after the infinitive marker to.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9 (quiz/game): Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence The finalists prepared slides, rehearsed speeches, and were answering questions. Which grammatical problem should the writer correct?
questions.explanation: The list mixes simple active verb forms with a passive form, so its grammatical elements are not parallel.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: In The proposal was praised by the committee, which voice is used?
questions.explanation: The construction is passive because the subject receives the action rather than performing it.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which gerund should replace the phrase to cycle in the sentence She enjoys hiking, swimming, and to cycle while preserving the original meaning?
questions.explanation: Cycling creates parallel gerund forms for hiking, swimming, and cycling while retaining the meaning of the original phrase to cycle.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: A writer checks the sentence After the game ended, the spectators returned back to their homes. Which one-word rubric category should flag the repeated meaning?
questions.explanation: The word back repeats the meaning already expressed by returned, making the phrase a redundancy.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which rubric category best describes the problem in The problem is the budget is too small?
questions.explanation: The sentence has faulty predication because the linking verb is is followed by a second subject and verb, and inserting that produces The problem is that the budget is too small.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which preposition correctly completes the sentence: The committee avoided making changes, but insisted on reviewing the proposal?
questions.explanation: The phrase insisted on reviewing correctly pairs the verb insist with on followed by a gerund.
questions.topic: Activity 7 of 9: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review

questions.prompt: Which one-word punctuation mark most directly joins the two independent clauses in The first round ended the judges began comparing scores?
questions.explanation: A semicolon can directly join two related independent clauses without creating a comma splice.
questions.topic: Write Your Own (Rubric Check) - Advanced Grammar Review
